$comment: RFC 0173 §A.1/§C — sideEffectSuppression is not a flag; suppression binds with replay and is witnessed by the effect-seam manifest at GET /host/effect-seams

modes.description: Fork modes (POST /runs/{runId}:fork `mode`): replay = deterministic re-execution with suppression; branch = divergent execution (branchReFires seams re-fire, RFC 0140 G6).

llmCacheKeyRecipe.description: RFC 0260 §A–§B (normative home). The cache-key recipe for every LLM-calling node. Absent ⇒ the RFC 0041 recipe (replay.md). Present ⇒ the host MUST compute every LLM-calling node's key as lowercase hex SHA-256 over JCS of {recipe, model, provider, messages, tools, toolChoice, responseSchema, params}; params MUST name temperature, maxTokens, stop, seed, topP, topK, frequencyPenalty, presencePenalty (null when not sent; stop sorted by UTF-16 code unit and de-duplicated), with every other output-shaping parameter under params.extra; a string message content is one text part; request, trace, tenant, run, node ids, timestamps and credentials MUST NOT enter the key. A host advertising this MUST advertise idempotency. A consumer MUST NOT act on an unrecognized value.
